The '''Cavalier Club''' was a business. The criminal Boss [[Gew'lek]] ordered a hit on the club. [[Locara]] objected to the operation, and demanded compensation from Gew'lek. She took a [[power cane]] with her to back up her claim.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
